=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_labels.py:985-988 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `_drain_retired_label` docstring still calls the comment POST "single-attempt" and "never retried", but `_github_api_request` (lines 230-233, 258-264) now retries HTTP 429 up to `GITHUB_API_MAX_ATTEMPTS` even when `retry_transient=False`.
  WHY: Runtime behaviour is unaffected, but the documented per-item API budget now undercounts, because a rate-limited comment POST can cost up to 3 calls; all four reviewers rated this NIT; fix: change the wording to "only an HTTP 429 is retried; 5xx and timeouts are not" (1-2 lines).
- scripts/ai_labels.py:263-267 (with _github_retry_delay_seconds 209-214, _github_retry_header_delay_seconds 186-197; .github/workflows/sync_ai_labels.yml:43) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new 429 retry on the drain comment POST sleeps for the server-provided Retry-After or rate-limit-reset delay, and that delay is not capped against the workflow's five-minute job timeout.
  WHY: A long delay makes Actions kill the job while it sleeps, so the remaining items are skipped and the drain returns no normal result (the label is kept for a later run); severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, luna and glm NIT (glm notes the helper is pre-existing and already used on every GET, and that the outcome is self-healing); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this as not new and fail-safe.
- tests/test_ai_labels_retired.py:test_repo_contract_retires_the_claude_session_labels | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The contract test supposedly expects retired labels to be deleted at once, which conflicts with the new drain that keeps the label until its open items are drained, so the pre-push test gate fails.
  WHY: Gemini rated this BLOCKER; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute it: the test (lines 78-86) only loads `CONTRACT_PATH` (`.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`) and checks list membership, and the failure comes from that file being missing in the sandbox, not from this change.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

(No task gaps reported.)

- scripts/ai_labels.py:`_drain_retired_label` docstring, lines 986-987 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The docstring says the comment POST is "never retried", but `_github_api_request` (lines 263-264) now retries HTTP 429 up to `GITHUB_API_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (3) when `retry_transient=False`; the inline comment (lines 230-233) and the agents.d fragment were updated, but the docstring was not.
  WHY: Runtime is unaffected, but the documented API budget undercounts and misleads anyone reasoning about duplicate comments; fix: "only an HTTP 429 is retried; 5xx and timeouts are not" (2 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1) (2 related items: finding + hardening suggestion).
- (dispositions) scripts/ai_labels.py:258-272; scripts/ai_labels.py:202-219; tests/test_ai_labels_retired.py:78-86
  PROBLEM: Verified the retry loop as correct: on "429 then 502" with `retry_transient=False`, the 502 is not retried, so no duplicate comment can be posted; `test_drain_comment_post_retries_a_rate_limit` covers the 429 path. Rejected luna's uncapped-429-delay finding because the uncapped delay is pre-existing behaviour and the outcome is fail-safe. Rejected gemini's contract-test BLOCKER because the test only checks contract membership and `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json` is missing from the checkout.
  WHY: Task completeness: NONE; every issue #8293 deliverable is present; keeping `issues: write` without `pull-requests: write` is documented and allowed by the issue's wording.

  PROBLEM: The existing contract test expects retired labels to be deleted at once, but the new drain keeps the label until every item carrying it is drained, which can take several runs.
  WHY: The pre-push test gate fails because the test assertion conflicts with the requirement not to delete labels before their open items are drained.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:_github_api_request, lines 263-267; _github_retry_delay_seconds, lines 209-214 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new 429 retry waits for the server-provided Retry-After or reset delay without capping it to the workflow's job timeout.
  WHY: A delay longer than the remaining job time makes the sync sleep until the runner kills it, which skips the remaining items and returns no drain result, so the label stays for a future run.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:_drain_retired_label, lines 986-987 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The docstring says "single-attempt" and "never retried", which contradicts the 429 retries in `_github_api_request`.
  WHY: The documented API-call contract misleads maintainers, who would undercount the budget; a rate-limited comment POST can cost up to 3 calls.

  PROBLEM: The docstring still says "one single-attempt ``POST repos/{repo}/issues/{n}/comments`` ... (never retried, so a lost response cannot post the comment twice)", but `_github_api_request` (lines 230-233, 258-264) now retries HTTP 429 when `retry_transient=False`; the inline comment and the agents.d fragment were updated, but this docstring was not.

  PROBLEM: The 429 retry for `retry_transient=False` sleeps for the raw Retry-After / reset delay with no upper cap once it exceeds `GITHUB_API_BACKOFF_CAP_SECONDS`, and the drain comment POST now goes through this path.
  WHY: A primary-rate-limit 429 can sleep past the workflow budget, so Actions kills the job and skips the remaining items; the outcome is self-healing, and the helper is pre-existing, so this is marginal; fix: cap the delay for this call (≤10 lines).
